z-m-30-01.title: Me zai biyo bayan 1, 2, 4?
z-m-30-01.topic: Ƙarfin matris: ƙimomi nawa ake buƙata kafin a tabbatar da tsari?
z-m-30-01.goal: Ka fahimci cewa a ƙarfin matris, ƙa'idoji da dama na iya dacewa da ƙimomi kaɗan. Ka tantance ƙa'idojin da za su yiwu, ka gyara hukuncinka yayin tafiya, sannan ka bayyana cewa za a iya tabbatar da ƙa'ida ta gama-gari ne kawai bayan an gano dalili (tsarin).
z-m-30-01.material: B matris 2×2 ce, kuma shigarwarta huɗu (jeri na 1 ginshiƙi na 1, jeri na 1 ginshiƙi na 2, jeri na 2 ginshiƙi na 1, jeri na 2 ginshiƙi na 2) duk 1 ne. B^n ita ce matris da ake samu ta ninka B sau n. Dukkan shigarwa lambobi na ainihi ne, n kuma lamba cikakkiya ce aƙalla 1. Abokai biyu suna magana game da shigarwar B³. Ɗaya ya ce, ‘Shigarwar B¹ da B² su ne 1 da 2, saboda haka B³=3,’ ɗayan kuma ya ce, ‘Ban tabbata ba tukuna. Mu ƙara ninkawa.’ Duk lokacin da aka bayyana bayani, ka gyara ko ka riƙe hukuncinka.
z-m-30-01.thinking.0: Yayin faɗaɗa ƙa'ida daga ƙananan bayanai, ka yi la'akari da sauran ƙa'idojin da za su iya yiwuwa ma
z-m-30-01.thinking.1: Daidaita hukunci da matakin tabbaci bisa sabon bayani
z-m-30-01.thinking.2: Nemo layin farko da ya yi kuskure a warwarewa, sannan ka bayyana dalili
z-m-30-01.thinking.3: Ƙirƙirar ƙa'ida ta gama-gari da haruffa (p, n) da bayyana dalili
z-m-30-01.prereq.0: Ninkar matris 2×2 (shigarwa ɗaya na sakamako = jimillar ninkar shigarwar jeri ɗaya na matrisin farko da ginshiƙi ɗaya na na baya) da ƙarfin A^n=A da aka ninka sau n
z-m-30-01.prereq.1: Karanta furuci masu haruffa n da p da gano sauƙaƙan tsarin lambobi
z-m-30-01.prereq.2: Hasashen tsarin karatu: H2 na wannan aiki alamar wahala ce kawai a samarwa, ba yana nufin Ma'aikatar Ilimi ta ware abun cikin ga wani aji ba. Ana ɗauka yana zuwa nan da nan bayan koyon ninkar matris, kuma ba a buƙatar induksiyon ko determinant.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayani ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane mataki, zaɓi hukuncinka na yanzu game da shigarwar ƙarfin B.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, rubuta duk ƙa'idojin da suka dace da lambobin zuwa yanzu, sannan ka kwatanta waɗanne ne sabon bayani ya kawar.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ka bincika ko ka zaɓi ne bisa ƙa'ida guda ɗaya kawai, ko kuwa ka yi la'akari da wasu ƙa'idoji ma.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.info: B¹ ita ce B kanta, saboda haka shigarwa huɗu duk 1 ne. Da aka ninka B² kai tsaye, shigarwa huɗun duk 2 ne.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Shigarwar B³ fa? Zaɓi hukuncinka na yanzu.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Bayanai biyun suna dacewa da 3 da 4 duka. Za ka iya ɗaukar ƙa'ida guda a matsayin ‘hasashe na aiki’, amma kafin gwaji yana da ma'ana a bar hukuncinka a buɗe.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Dukkan shigarwa 3 ne. Bayan 1, 2, ƙa'idar ƙaruwa da 1 tana ci gaba
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Akwai wasu ƙa'idoji da suka dace da 1, 2 ban da ‘ƙaruwa da 1’. Tare da bayanai biyu kawai ya yi wuri a tabbatar da ƙa'ida guda.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Dukkan shigarwa 4 ne. Bayan 1, 2, ƙa'idar ninkawa da 2 tana ci gaba
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ƙa'idar ninka biyu ma tana dacewa da 1,2, haka kuma 'ƙara 1'. Ka lura ya yi wuri a zaɓi ɗaya a tabbata. (1, 2)
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ba za mu iya bambance 3 da 4 yanzu ba, don haka lissafta B³ kai tsaye ta ninkawa.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ka gane cewa maki biyun bayanai sun dace da ƙa'idodi da dama, ka jinkirta hukunci, har ka yi tunanin matakin dubawa (ninkawa kai tsaye).
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Dukkan abubuwa 2 ne. Matrix ne mai abu iri ɗaya a ko'ina, don haka ƙima ba ta ƙara canzawa.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: A B² ƙimar ta riga ta canza daga 1 zuwa 2. Kasancewar abubuwa iri ɗaya ba yana nufin ƙimar ba ta canza ba.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Idan aka faɗaɗa B³ kai tsaye, duk abubuwa huɗun 4 ne. Har yanzu jerin 1,2,4 ne. Ƙa'idar da ta dace ba 'ninka biyu' kaɗai ba ce. Tara ƙimomi biyun baya sannan ƙara 1 yana ba da 1,2,4,7,... kuma wannan ma ya dace. (1, 1, 2, 2, 4, 7)
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Mene ne hukuncinka yanzu game da B⁴?
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Saboda B³, an kawar da 'ƙara 1'. Amma ba za a iya bambance ƙa'idar ninka biyu da jerin 1,2,4,7 sai an lissafta B⁴. Ana buƙatar ƙarin bayanai ko nemo dalili. (1, 2, 4, 7)
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Tabbatar da ƙa'idar ninka biyu, rubuta duk abubuwan B⁴ su zama 8.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Gaskiya ne ƙimomi ukun sun dace da ninka biyu, amma ƙa'idar 1,2,4,7 ma ta dace. Ba ka bambance su tukuna. (1, 2, 4, 7)
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ɗauki 4 na B³ a matsayin kuskuren lissafi, ka ci gaba da ƙa'idarka ta farko cewa duka 3 ne.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Idan ka ce lissafin kai tsaye kuskure ne, za ka iya riƙe hukuncinka na farko amma babu hujja. Sake duba lissafi ya bambanta da watsar da shi.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Akwai ƙa'idodi da dama, don haka kada ka yi hasashe daga wannan bayanin sam.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: 'Ƙara 1' ba ya dace kuma. Ragewar adadin ƙa'idodin da suka rage ita ma bayani ce.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Cire 'ƙara 1', ka bambance sauran ƙa'idoji biyu da B⁴.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ka cire ƙa'idar da ba ta dace da bayanai, har ka yi tunanin hanyar bambance ragowar ƙa'idojin.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Na nemo dalili. A ce duk abubuwan B^n lamba k ɗaya ce. Wani abu na B^(n+1)=B^n×B shi ne (k×1)+(k×1)=2k. Lissafi ɗaya ne ga duk abubuwa huɗu. Duk abubuwan B¹ kuma 1 ne.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yanzu mene ne hukuncinka ga abubuwan B^n da B⁵?
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.after: Siffar da duk abubuwa iri ɗaya ce tana ci gaba, ƙimar kuma tana ninkuwa da 2; saboda haka abubuwan B^n su ne 2^(n−1). Hukuncin da aka bari a buɗe tun farko ('3 ko 4?') ya takaita ta bayanai → ƙa'idojin yiwuwa → dalili. Ɗalibin da ya lissafta B⁴ kai tsaye ma zai kai ƙarshe ɗaya.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Abubuwan B^n duk n ne, na B⁵ kuma duk 5 ne.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ƙa'idar n ta riga ta gaza ga B³. Haka kuma ba ta dace da sabon bayani ba (2k kowane ninkawa).
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Abubuwan B^n duk 2^(n−1) ne, na B⁵ kuma duk 16 ne.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka danganta shi da dalilin cewa 'kowane ninkawa yana ba da 2k' ga kowane n.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Wataƙila 2^(n−1) ne, amma ba zan tabbatar ba sai na faɗaɗa B⁵ kai tsaye.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Sha'awar dubawa abu ne mai kyau. Amma sabon bayani dalili ne da ya shafi kowane n. Ka yi tunanin yadda wannan dalili ke shafar tabbacin.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: B⁴=7 ne, saboda haka B⁵ duk 12 ne.
z-m-30-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ka ci gaba da ƙa'idar 1,2,4,7. Duba ko ta dace da sabon bayani cewa k yana zama 2k. (1, 2, 4, 7)
z-m-30-01.s.s1.reflect: Daga jinkirin hukunci da farko zuwa tabbaci a ƙarshe, me ya canza tabbacin? Menene bambancin ƙarin maki uku da nemo 'dalili'?
z-m-30-01.s.s2.prompt: Hayun abokin aji ya samo abubuwan ƙarfin C=3B (matrix mai abubuwa 3 huɗu) kamar haka. Zaɓi layin farko da kuskure ya fara.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi abu ɗaya na C, ka lissafta kai tsaye abu (layi 1, ginshiƙi 1) na C da aka ninka da kansa sau biyu.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta ƙimar kai tsaye da layukan, nemo na farko da suka bambanta.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.line.1: Dukkan abubuwan B²=2, saboda haka abubuwan C² duk 3×2=6 ne.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.line.2: Haka kuma C³=3B³, duk abubuwan B³=4, saboda haka abubuwan C³=3×4=12.
z-m-30-01.s.s2.line.3: Saboda haka abubuwan C^n su ne 3×2^(n−1).
z-m-30-01.s.s2.explain: A layi na 1, constant 3 yana cikin kowane factor biyun amma an cire shi sau ɗaya kawai. A (3B)(3B), 3 yana bayyana sau biyu, saboda haka C²=9B², abubuwa duka 9×2=18 ne. Idan aka ɗaga C murabba'i kai tsaye, abu guda 3×3+3×3=18, ya bambanta da 6. Layi na 2-4 sun gaji furucin kuskuren layi na 1. Layi na 3 ma, domin C³=27B³, abubuwa kuma 108 ne.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.prompt: A wannan karon yi la'akari da matrix P mai abubuwa huɗu p (p lambar cikakkiya tabbatacciya ce). Bayyana abubuwan P^n, ninkawar P sau n, da p,n, sannan ka rubuta dalili.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.hint.0: Idan p=1 da p=2, faɗaɗa P² kai tsaye ka kwatanta abubuwa.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.hint.1: Rubuta dangantakar abubuwan P² da P da p a matsayin furuci, duba ko haka ma yake faruwa ga P³.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: abubuwan P^n su ne ... saboda ...
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin a furucina, idan p=1, abu 2^(n−1) na B^n ya sake fitowa?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin na duba cewa ya dace da ƙimomin da aka ninka kai tsaye idan n=1 da n=2?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Shin na rubuta jigon dalilin, kamar 'me ya sa lissafa abu guda ya isa' ko 'ta fitar da B a matsayin factor'?
z-m-30-01.s.s3.model.0: Abubuwan P^n duka p^n×2^(n−1) ne. Idan P=pB, to P^n=p^nB^n, abubuwan B^n kuma suna ninkuwa da 2.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.modelNote.0: Hanyar fitar da B a matsayin factor
z-m-30-01.s.s3.model.1: Abubuwa suna zama p,2p²,4p³,..., kowane ninkawa guda yana ninka su da 2p. Tsarin abubuwa huɗu iri ɗaya ne kuma abu guda p×k+p×k=2pk ne, saboda haka abubuwan P^n p×(2p)^(n−1) ne.
z-m-30-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Hanyar da ta fara daga canjin ninkawa guda. Furucin iri ɗaya ne da amsar baya.
